ModMetaData.name: Jawa Utinni Statues
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Statues of the Utinni faith (STATUE_ART_EXPANSION_1, design/RimMandrake/statue_mods_spec.md, Mod 1).
The sculptor's table can carve an Utinni votive (small), statue (person-sized) or grand statue (2x2). Once one is placed, its "Dedicate" button chooses who it honours: any of the Nine (Ishko, Ohm, Oomo, Mob'Unloo, Rekko, Ta'Baa, Zizzik, Sh'kaar, Ozzik), grand idols of Ohm, Rekko and Sh'kaar, the sand-crawler relief, or the three votives (the Bandolier, the Droplet, the Tally). The carving, the name and the "Honours" line follow the choice. Any colony can carve them.
Sh'kaar's grand idol burns: dedicating a stone or metal grand statue to him rebuilds it as a fuelled idol (chemfuel; Sumpgas in the Utinni campaign) whose sun-disc crown carries a flame and lights the room. Rededicate it and it goes cold again.
Not here yet (filed): the carved art itself (each choice shows a vanilla sculpture until its picture lands), and the full set of flames on Sh'kaar's palms (comes with the Flame Statues mod).
Mod Settings ("Utinni Statues"): carving on/off, Sh'kaar's idol burns, Sumpgas fuels the idol.
